archive.access: public download through ordinary curl; no login, acceptance, or access-control bypass

local_draft.schema_validation: passed CLI validate_record; independent identifier authority gate not performed
local_draft.experimental_claims: none; structured assertions cite original BioPAX objects

limitations: 2019 archive is not established as identical to the current public pathway page.
Source pathway accessions, source xrefs and namespace normalization do not establish current independent identifier authority.
Stoichiometric coefficients are not represented in the generated edge model.
No physiological order is inferred from pathwayOrder membership; source has no nextStep links.
MolecularInteraction Interactions/33 and its otherwise unused small molecule are not represented; its inhibitory name alone is not promoted into a curated causal edge.
The source exports no PublicationXref objects; pathway prose citations are not imported as per-edge experiments.
Original archive, member XML and generated YAML remain in the external local cache pending public-release data review.
